response_text:
**Yes, DonorDock has online giving features.**

DonorDock provides "Online Giving Pages" that let nonprofits accept donations online for free (with a 1% platform fee on gifts). These connect directly to Stripe and PayPal (Stripe Connect required for full features), automatically recording donations in your DonorDock account in real time.

### Key Capabilities (from DonorDock's site and help center):
- **Create unlimited customizable pages**: For campaigns, appeals, events, memberships, pledges, tickets, honorariums, memorials, or anonymous gifts.
- **Payment options**: One-time, recurring (weekly/monthly/quarterly/annual), memberships, sponsorships; supports credit cards, Stripe, PayPal, DAFpay, and Square via Zapier.
- **Sharing methods**: Direct links, QR codes, text-to-donate (via DonorDock phone/keywords), website embeds (compatible with WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, etc.).
- **Security & automation**: SOC II certified, encrypted; auto tax receipts, thank-you emails, donor records, and imports from Stripe/PayPal.
- **Setup**: Log in > Online Giving > Add New Giving Page. Only admins manage it.

Evidence: Official pages like [donordock.com/online-giving](https://www.donordock.com/online-giving) promote it as a core feature; help docs detail setup ([e.g., here](https://helpcenter.donordock.com/kb/guide/en/creating-an-online-giving-page-IbwiiyR2at/Steps/1352614)) and confirm all gifts sync automatically. No conflicting info in results.
